title: Dire Wolf Pack
description: The dire pack has pushed out of the deep forest and onto the trap lines - three trappers won't walk them anymore. Guildmaster Tam Ashby isn't sending journeymen after wolves that size on a training contract, so this one goes up as a proper bounty, guild scrip against guild coin, for someone who has killed bigger than deer before.

objectives.description: Kill the dire wolves that have taken the trap lines

notes: Threat: three trappers have abandoned their lines to a dire wolf pack pushed out of the deep forest - lost income for men the guild depends on. Giver motive: Guildmaster Ashby won't risk journeymen on a pack this size, so the board carries the cost instead of the guild's own people. Refusal: the trap lines stay abandoned and the trappers' loss compounds.
